note: Registry data NOT verified in this session. All registry aggregators (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Tofler, InstaFinancials) returned HTTP 403/404 and the MCA master-data portal returned 403; the search backend (searx) was down and Bing/Google returned only generic Danfoss corporate pages, so no CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status or audited revenue could be read from a primary or secondary source. Therefore CIN/PAN/GSTIN/incorporation_date/mca_status/revenue are null — not invented. What IS confirmed from a first-party source: the company's own India site (https://www.danfoss.com/en-in/) lists the operating entity as 'Danfoss Industries Pvt Ltd', Plot No. A-19/2, SIPCOT Industrial Growth Centre, Oragadam, Kanchipuram District, Tamil Nadu — so the registered/operating state is Tamil Nadu, not the (empty) state claimed in the input. Role assessed as manufacturer_trader: Danfoss is a Danish industrial group and the Indian entity runs a SIPCOT Oragadam plant (local manufacturing of drives/compressors/controls) while also importing and distributing group products; this is an inference from the company's own site, not from MCA NIC codes. Declared HS 850440 (static converters / AC drives) is consistent with the Danfoss Drives (VLT/VACON) business, but HS is not a rejection criterion per project rules. No rejection grounds found: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy — but equally no registry confirmation of active status, so status must be re-checked against MCA/GST portals when those sources are reachable. Revenue FY25/FY26: null — no audited accounts or MCA filings were accessible; do not substitute group-level Danfoss A/S global figures.
